rows.text: The clock winds back to the start of the journey to Penacony — the Astral Express, upon invitation from the Watchmaker, heads to a Cosmic vacation spot, The Reverie hotel, for a banquet. However, in this Sweetdream Paradise, they unexpectedly become entangled in two bizarre "murder mysteries."

A grand struggle for a legacy begins. Numerous factions enter one after another, acting in response to the situation. The Family hosts also plot to capture the Watchmaker with this opportunity and ensure the Charmony Festival takes place as scheduled.

A confrontation between the Emanator of the Nihility, Acheron, and IPC representative, Aventurine, becomes the turning point of the entire event: The latter, through a "grand death," shatters The Family's lies and reveals the existence of the Primordial Dreamscape, Dreamflux Reef.

The Express Crew thus delves into the heart of the situation. Here, Gallagher reveals to everyone the truths about the dreamscape, the Stellaron, Mikhail, and the other Nameless. They finally uncover the legacy of the Trailblaze and, in doing so, receive a glimpse from the Harmony.

To fulfill the wishes of their predecessors, everyone heads to the Penacony Grand Theater with the intention of sealing the Stellaron. However, they are forced into a deadly battle against Sunday, the head of the Oak family, who is aligned with the Order. This great battle concludes with the fall of the Order once again.

The future of Penacony remains uncertain. However, thanks to the mediation of the Crew, The Family and the IPC agree to cede some of their interests, and reach a consensus. Penacony regains the right to determine its own destiny.

In the very end, Sparkle makes a grand return with a startling bomb show. This "crisis" is ultimately resolved amidst spectacular fireworks. With everyone receiving their own best ending, the tragicomedy of the sweet dream comes to a close.

rows.text: Governor? You humor me. I'm merely an educator. Here on our campus, our students are the true masters.
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: I came over after hearing of a ruckus in the Dreamweaving class, but it seems like it was these Sweet Dreams Troupe who went out of control. My apologies once again.
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: Pardon me, but I don't think I've seen you around here before. You're not a student of Paperfold University, are you?
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: I'm only asking because we know a stowaway has recently snuck into Penacony. Eyewitness accounts from the Bloodhounds describe someone with pink hair, red attire, and a blazing scarf... And you seem to match that description.
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: No need to beat around the bush, sir.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Of course. What I'm trying to say is...
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: If the stowaway is indeed plotting something nefarious, it wouldn't make sense for them to attend classes at Paperfold University. So, I'm certain you're just an inquisitive student.
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: Wait, what?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Every banana seedling has the potential to bear fruit, that's why everyone deserves bananenlightenment. Paperfold University advocates freedom in education, so feel free to sit in our classes and be sure to apply yourself!
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: Join me in a round of applause for our new student!
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: Wow, did you just challenge the BananAdvisor? That's SO COOL! I've always found him annoying!
rows.speaker: Excited Classmate

rows.text: Why do you call yourself a ninja? Are there really ninjas on your planet?
rows.speaker: Passionate Classmate

rows.text: Bana, bana!
rows.speaker: Nanabloom-chan

rows.text: R—Rappa...
rows.speaker: Chaletka

rows.text: Thank you for standing up for me earlier. Um, could you show me how you did that graffiti, I mean, your ninja move?
rows.speaker: Chaletka

rows.text: ...That's my ninjutsu. It's hard to teach it to others.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Bana, bana...
rows.speaker: Nanabloom-chan

rows.text: But I say with certainty that you will discover your own way of the ninja someday.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Yes, destiny is no different than a banana peel...
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: Like bananas within their peels, we can never break free of its encapsulation.
rows.speaker: "Profnana"

rows.text: My own way of the ninja...? I don't even know what that is. Maybe I should just practice monkey weaving, bana...
rows.speaker: Chaletka

rows.text: ...Bana?
rows.speaker: Chaletka

rows.text: Looks like things blew up real quick... Everyone's flocked here to see what's going on.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Geez, please tell me they're still duking it out with the teacher!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Hey, isn't that Montana?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, Say~Cheese~! And Dan Heng and Superstar too! We meet again!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Um... I came up with that name on the fly, so let's forget about it. Just call me March!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Previously on Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions
To defeat Evil Ninja Osaru, this girl has become the successor to the Dazzling Ninjutsu, adopting the codename of Rappa, she began training under Master Kucha.
To help Rappa master the secrets of the ninja arts, Master Kucha subjected her to harsh trials. And Rappa, in her quest to liberate the Ninja Capital from darkness, determinedly endured every test.
Master Kucha is aware that Rappa is maturing into a true ninja, and her destined mission will soon unfold...
61st Year of Ninja Era, Dazzling Dojo, the Ninja Capital
Gotcha. You can drop "Montana" too! I'm now known as Denisovan 426!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Denisovan... 426?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right, I finally got into the Slumbernana Association — the GOAT club at Paperfold University! And that's my name in the club!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Pfft! Real names are boring and not special at all!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: I don't know, but it was decided by the club. Maybe members in this tier are more capable, haha!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: That's my membership number. Each member has their own unique number!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: The Slumbernana Association was founded by fans of Slumbernana Monkey. Our fan base stretches far beyond the campus and includes Ripe Bananas from all over Penacony!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: We create fan art and merch based on Slumbernana, host Slumbernana Cons, and hold a few other off-campus events from time to time. Itching to join us? I can refer you!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Wow, that sounds like a lot of fun! Can you get all of us in?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Count on me! It's just that the club has a rigorous screening procedure and we only take in a few members each time. If I refer March in, then the two of you...
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: I'll pass.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A while ago...
Okie-dokie! This coveted spot will go to March then! Ooh, there's an off-campus event happening later today at a supposedly mysterious location. I can't wait!
rows.speaker: Montana

rows.text: Great! Let me say goodbye to those two, and then you can show me where to sign up.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Good job playing along back there, guys!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Things are getting weirder, huh? This monkey even has a fan club now. But since we have a way to get into the club, I'll go see what they're up to!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Will you be alright on your own?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yeah, it's less suspicious than all three of us joining the club together. Let's split up for now. This way, you two can keep an eye on what's going on in the campus.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Please be careful.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Aww, I will. Don't worry about me! You too, [Trailblazer]. Catch you guys later!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I hope she'll be okay. Profnana was clearly steering the conversation his way earlier. Let's go find Rappa and hear what she thinks...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What was that?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Slumbernana Monkey? I see a tag on it: "Peelin' Richie, Fortune Academy."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is the toy you ordered. It looks rather unique.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Bana! Bana!
rows.speaker: Broken Monkey

rows.text: ...It ran off. What now?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Dazzling Ninja greets each ninja present. This action seems superfluous, but is a courtesy that cannot be ignored by a ninja.
Alright, let's go get the toy back then.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Isn't this the way to the Fortune Academy?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Rappa? When did she get ahead of us?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The dreamweaving BananAdvisor sways their head. The class bell rings, drawing all the students around.
Give me a break, Miss! I'll repeat this for the millionth time: I'm not evil, nor do I sell any gorge roe!
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: BananAdvisor hands out a can of spray paint to the students, but you can't feel the weight of the can at all, as if it were empty.
Nay, Ninja Initiate Merchant! The other initiates have verified that these fiendling puppets are from your shop. Confess at once! Are you under the spell of Evil Ninja Osaru?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Oh! Hey! It's you! Please, help me talk some sense into her. I'm just a well-behaved student working to pay my tuition fees, not whatever "initiate" she thinks I am!
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Never mind that. The monkey you sold us keeps running off on its own. Are you sure it's just a toy?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Fiendling puppets imbued with life... The epitome of Ninja Automation.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The Dreamweaver BananAdvisor raises the spray can, and colorful ink droplets splatter out. The colored ink seems to come to life, flowing, surging, and blending on the wall, creating ever-changing images...
You rich folks are just being unreasonable! If it were really some high-end stuff, would I be selling it at such a low price?
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Please, take pity on this poor student! Have a heart! As if squeezing in sales between classes isn't enough, I haven't slept a wink in three days, just so I can get this batch of toys ready!
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Richie! Bana tsk! How could you speak so rudely to your customers?
F—Fortune BananAdvisor!
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: "The customer is always right!" Did I not teach you that? Greetings, dear students...
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: This fiendling assumes the form of an insect-like pest. Clearly a lowly fiendling.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Wh—What did you just say!? Bana grr! Repeat that if you dare!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Psst, BananAdvisor! "The customer is always right!"
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Ahem, pardon me... My dear students, you may have some misunderstanding about Fortune Academy's new product.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: These monkey toys are made this lively so that they bring more emotional value to our young customers.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Paperfold University might seem to be an enjoyable place, but beneath their peels, many students are in fact bogged down by loneliness. You know... Struggling to embrace the vibrant energy here in the Moment of Sol, but also realizing that they're unable to live as the Penaconians do.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: This pristine wall is about to change, taking on your colors. Just thinking about it makes your tiny hand, clutching the dream paint, tremble with excitement.
This will be a masterpiece that transforms Paperfold University. To ensure you have no regrets about your youth, you must carefully plan the content of this painting.

From color schemes to composition, from the big picture to the smallest detail, from concept to design — it deserves not just a system hour, not just a day, but an entire year of meticulous refinement! Make your mark on the history of dream art!

But the Slumbernana Monkey is the perfect companion! It won't compete for grades, won't compare itself to you, won't use your things without asking. You can trust it completely, without worrying about it sharing your secrets with others. Consider it your bestest palnana!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Unfortunately, this clueless monkey interrupted your daydream. But he did remind you of one thing: Time is always the most precious resource in creation.
You close your eyes, and begin meditating as instructed by BananAdvisor—
Bana gosh, look at the time! I have to get ready for my Dreamscape Marketing class!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Exactly, think about the things that bring you peace—
Hold on, you've never even been to the beach. Where did this memory come from?
The BananAdvisor demands a Slumbernana Monkey, but do you really have to follow it to the letter?
Excuse me, students. I'll take all other questions after class.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: For some reason, your voice of doubt is drowned out by the Banagibberish of the little monkey. It seemed to be the will of the paint can itself. The sound of the monkey keeps echoing in your ears, and images of the little monkey begin to appear in your mind...
There's no choice now. It seems your painting will have to be of the monkey...
I should get to my class too. But do me a favor buddies, just come look for me if you need anything. Let's not involve BananAdvisor again...
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: This is... the Mysterious Trashcan you once helped— it's Shatana! She has subdued the little monkey!
I doubt he'll say anything more. Let's just follow him and see what we can learn.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This atmosphere... is this... really a marketing class?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Behold, the sensational B-wave that's been raking in all the money these days!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Eat bananas, nap the day away. Worry no more, be happy everyday!
rows.speaker: TV Speaker

rows.text: The power of the can and the monkey battles and merges within you, ultimately channeling into the paint on your fingertips. The scents of bananas and garbage intertwine in your nostrils, while two distinct images emerge in your mind...
Now, let's take some time to think about this slogan. What is it about Slumbernana Monkey that allowed it to spark a banana frenzy in Penacony?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Everything is ready! Show your talent and unleash yourself on the canvas of the wall—
How about that gray-haired student— Wait, what are you doing here!? Oh, never mind. You can answer the question then.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Bana bana! There's no denying how cute Slumbernana Monkey is, but that's just one of its selling points. More importantly, it addresses the pain point of Penaconian consumers!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Not quite. While Banagibberish and Bananese helped propagate the banana craze, the key lies in how Slumbernana Monkey addresses the pain point of Penaconian consumers!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Bingo! To live a happy life! That is exactly the pain point of Penaconian consumers!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Both rich and poor alike come to Penacony in the hope of leading a more fulfilling life.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Unfortunately, a couple of days in the Dreamscape is all it takes for them to realize this is nothing more than a fantasy. Dreamchasers soon give in to exhaustion and tourists eventually grow weary from the endless festivities.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Those famed tycoons and Festive Superstars that we pursue lead lives we can never hope to experience... So dramatic, eventful, and out of this world.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: But Slumbernana Monkey epitomizes a wholly different lifestyle! Sleeping and snacking on bananas without a care in the world... This is what pure happiness should be!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I have just the thing to help all of you understand this better. Fortune Academy students get a bonus discount when purchasing this special model of the Slumbernana Monkey toy...
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: BananAdvisor, I sold everything from the last batch.
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: That's fantastic news! We underestimated Slumbernana Monkey's popularity. Come with me, Richie. I'll get you more stock.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: So, the Fortune Academy's supposed to promote these toys. But why did they rope students into their plan?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Bana bana bana...
rows.speaker: Slumbernana Monkey

rows.text: It's a shame we don't understand its Banagibberish...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...I have an idea, [Trailblazer]. Can you use Clockwork on it?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm counting on you, bana.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We'll find out, but this is one way to confirm some of our assumptions.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Clockwork ninjutsu! Silvergun Shura once recounted its magnificence to me. Please, it will be my honor to witness it with my own eyes.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: I'll leave it to you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Bana...
rows.speaker: Broken Monkey

rows.text: It's working. It seems to be leading us somewhere. Let's catch up.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (Why does it feel like I've been on a wild monkey chase all day...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's Ninja Initiate Merchant and Fiendling Pest—
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: You reach out to feel its quality, but the Slumbernana Monkey is startled and suddenly bolts away...
Hold on. Let's listen in on their conversation first.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Uh, Fortune BananAdvisor? Aren't we supposed to pick up more stock? I don't see anything here.
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Geez, Dreamwaver BananAdvisor said he'd get a new batch ready. Looks like we can't rely on him, bana tsk!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: By the way, BananAdvisor...
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Did those people... willingly become monkeys?
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Why, of course, Richie. Can't you see how happy it is being a monkey?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I... guess not.
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: I take it you haven't been paying attention in class, huh? Or did those guest students plant unrealistic ideas in your head again?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Do you have the slightest idea about the backgrounds of those Nameless? You're just a poor student from a faraway fringe planet, one that relies on the IPC for aid! Do you really think you can compare yourself to them?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: ...I know I can't measure up to those bigwigs, but there are things I hope to achieve too...
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: I get it. You're aiming to make a lot of money. After all, the sky-high tuition fees at Paperfold University can really take a toll on the average middle-class family.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Oh, I heard your father came to Penacony, too. He's been working day and night ever since taking up a new job at Dawn Factory, hasn't he? Aww bana, how touching!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: H—How did you know that?
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Bana bana! He swung by a few days ago to check on how you're doing.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I took the time to chat with him. Looking at how old he is, my heart really went out to him. Throwing in most of his life savings, only to slog his guts out in a foreign land... I could sense his exhaustion and distress.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: So, I instilled in him the tenets of our banacademics, convincing him that becoming a Slumbernana Monkey is the right thing to do. Oh, that's right! He's in the batch of toys that you just delivered. Quite a turn of events, huh?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Wh—What? How could you!
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Could it be... the father of Ninja Initiate Merchant, Merchant Chief?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Why? Because your dad was simply too tired. I asked if he ever had regrets, and he said no. But when I stripped away that banana peel facade, what I found was the expulsion warning letter you had hidden.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Bana bana bana...
rows.speaker: Broken Monkey

rows.text: ♪ Ba na na na~ Ba na na na~ ♪
rows.speaker: TV Speaker

rows.text: Of course, bana... Why didn't I realize this sooner? You're a hopeless student. Rather than squandering our educational resources on you, why don't you become one of Fortune Academy's products? At least scrape some worth out of yourself, bana hyuk hyuk!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I assured your father that you'll get to be happy like him. It's time for you to rest, Richie.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Wh—Why did it come to this!? What use is it for me keeping up the struggle if you've already given up, Dad...?
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Dad, there's nothing else keeping me going...
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Something's happening to Richie! We have to stop him!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Fiendling Pest! What tricks did you pull on Ninja Initiate Merchant?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: ♪ Ba na na na~ Ba na na na~ ♪
rows.speaker: TV Speaker

rows.text: Gah! How did a ninja get in here!?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I have no hands to begin with, bana.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: That's not the point.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Please see more value in your life!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Hold your bananas, students. Allow me to explain myself.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: I was only trying to help relieve those pitiful kids of their suffering, letting them enjoy the rest of their happy life from a different perspective... And maybe make some extra cash while I'm at it, but this isn't anything new in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: You may have your esteemed background and a never-ending supply of credits, but that's not the case for my students. All I did was offer a better alternative, one that both father and son willingly took up.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Seems like a fair and banaworthy deal, wouldn't you say so?
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: As stated in the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions: "Sizzling yakitori knows not refreshing ice, as chilled sashimi knows not blazing fire." If Ninja Initiate Merchant has indeed chosen the way of the fiend, it is not my place to intervene.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Bana geez! I didn't count on you being this reasonable.
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Your words alone will not suffice. Ninja Initiate Merchant, is this truly your intention?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: He does not seem capable of a response. Merchant Chief, is this a willing decision of yours?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: ...Bana?
rows.speaker: Slumbernana Monkey

rows.text: Deceitful fiendling! You spoke with a forked tongue! They can't prove a word of your claims.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Have you gone bananas!? Monkeys can't speak the human language!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: In that case... Your calling is to render those in misery blind and deaf? Utter absurdity!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The path to hell is paved with heavenly treasure; devils trying to fool you, better get your head together. The hunters hide greed with a welcoming smile; don't be beguiled, it could be your last mile.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Censure shall not fall upon the ensnared ninja initiate, but the trap's orchestrator ought to be punished. I beckon the Ninja Hunt upon you! Say your final words, Fiendling Pest!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The banana was that? Assistananas, beat her to a pulp!
rows.speaker: Fortune BananAdvisor

rows.text: Resorting to sorcery to turn ninjas into fiendlings... Dreadfully horrid.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Looks like he completely malfunctioned.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Something's awry. I believe I should've held back in the ninja battle just now... Perhaps someone is controlling these fiendlings behind the scenes?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Bana...
rows.speaker: Broken Monkey

rows.text: No matter. The fiendling deserves its rightful punishment. Ninja Initiate Merchant, though...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Bana...
rows.speaker: Tired Monkey

rows.text: Ninja Initiate Merchant succumbed to their sorcery. He is expected to be out of action for a while.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Miss Rappa, can we talk about why the Rangers came to Penacony now?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Did you pick up on something, Ninja Hiryū?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Even though I had doubts before, it was only when I saw this that I felt sure of it. The sworn enemy of the Galaxy Rangers, the horrific scientist who transforms humans into monkeys, the Evil Ninja Osaru you spoke of...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's Dr. Primitive, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Bana.
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: Astute. Evil Ninja Osaru... it's definitely Evil Ninja Osaru.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Member #64 of the Genius Society, Dr. Primitive. No one knows his real name, but his atrocities are infamous throughout the cosmos. The most horrifying one of all has to be his atavistic experiment.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The dozens of worlds he caught up in this experiment were mostly home to prosperous interstellar civilizations, but every single one of these planets was reduced to a regressed form of intelligence by the time he was done with them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Intellitrons deteriorated into mere machines, Zatzkas regressed into birds, and even the most ubiquitous human civilizations were subjected to the same fate: Millions of apes and monkeys now wander amidst the ruins that they once called home.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If Dr. Primitive is indeed behind this, we must alert the Astral Express and The Family at once. We won't be able to avert this crisis on our own. Facing such an amoral Emanator of Erudition... even the slightest of negligence could bring unimaginable consequences.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Your analysis is accurate. However, in my humble opinion, now may not be the best time to call the Harmony Shogunate for aid.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: As stated in the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions: "When the net is cast for a catch, ready yourself to land a fish or forgo your net." With Evil Ninja Osaru lurking in the shadows and our locations not yet compromised, I suggest laying low to avoid alerting the monkeys.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Rest assured, I've delegated Silvergun Shura to investigate the forbidden ground. Being the chivalrous and exceptional Ninja Hero he is, I have faith Silvergun Shura will accomplish the assigned mission.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: At this juncture, our priority is to rescue the ninja initiates of Paperfold Town. What Ninja Heroes would we be if left those defenseless initiates to the monkeys? If we don't rescue those before us, how can we hope to save the world?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: ...Bana?
rows.speaker: Richie

rows.text: ...Indeed, we must not leave the students to fend for themselves.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There you are. I've finally found you, my beloved talents!
It's... Ninja Gama?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Oh? I see this actor is creative with her words.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Mr. Reca? Do you need our help with something?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ah, yes. Charmony Academy is filming a promotional video for their anniversary, but the BananAdvisor hasn't found anyone that makes the cut. That's why I'm here: To recruit students with greater acting potential—
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Like you, a big shot with a brilliant past! And you, a superstar that everyone will have their eyes on! And this... actress with personality! Please join us in the performance!
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Considering how Charmony BananAdvisor's a creator of the Slumbernana Monkey, I believe only young and talented people such as yourselves will be the ones to catch her discerning eye.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: I see. Thank you for thinking so highly of us, Mr. Reca. We'll make sure to drop by.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's the way! We'll be at the photography studio. See you later.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Bana, bana, bana...
rows.speaker: Tired Monkey

rows.text: Bana, bana...
rows.speaker: Broken Monkey

rows.text: Yeah, you came here to enjoy campus life, so why are you getting caught up in this mess? What do these *banana* troubles have to do with you anyway?
Your journey always seems like this: forced to take risks, forced to strive, forced to solve problems, with no freedom at all. Can't you ever truly choose to "give the *banana* up"?
Hey. You have more memetic viruses on you than the number of trashy Penaconian films released this month. If you wander outside and provoke those monkeys again, you're really going to be done for!
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Don't listen to him. Make a truly free choice and embrace the *banana* freedom of a monkey's life!
Phew! At the last possible moment, you conquered the inner Banagibberish.
Baseball Bat Ninja, are you ready to dive into my past? Make all necessary preparations, for you may be jolted out of sorts when we encounter the bloody, tearful, and ruthless moments in my memory.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Ninjas only strike when the opportunity presents itself. Waiting might be the right course of action to take for now.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: When you enter this door, the Dreamscape's space begins to twist, and you once again return to Mr. Reca's set.
(The Banagibberish in my mind is getting clearer now... I have to move quickly...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Please, let me apologize once more. Yes, it is true that I had a working relationship with Profnana, but I was coerced into it. As a memetic lifeform, I inadvertently fell into the hands of my enemies and became infected with a lethal memetic virus.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: No, not those. I have a much bigger role than those extras.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: No... at least not right now.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Previously on Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions

Destiny elongates time, in the same way ramen noodles are stretched. The Ninja Capital has turned into an abyssal hell under the devastation of Evil Ninja Osaru. Even the mighty Lan would rather close THEIR eyes to the capital's sorry state and let out a long sigh...

The only remaining ninja, Dazzling Ninja AKA Rappa, has trained an entire decade under the tutelage of Master Kucha to be adept in a wide variety of ninjutsu, gaining also the ability to recite lengthy mantras fluently.

But deep down Master Kucha is aware that it is only when Rappa receives the tutelage of other Ninja Heroes and embarks upon the paramount way of the ninja as Dazzling Ninja can she save the entire Ninja Capital.
In the darkest hour of the night, a falling meteor streaks across the sky, marking the graduation of Ninja Initiate Rappa and her new identity as Ninja Hero Rappa...
The Ninja Capital
In the suburban night fog, the streets are colorless, save for the neon signs scattered about, the splendid hues of Dazzling Ninja Seals, and the swift silhouette of the Dazzling Ninja herself.

What's scattered on the ground like garbage bags are not plastic garbage. Instead, they are the lackeys of the Osaru. The one casting their shadow in front of the Dazzling Ninja is not a dead spirit, but rather an unknown visitor who exudes a powerful and suppressive power...
Greetings. Who might you be?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: My pleasure to make your acquaintance too. We are Ninja Heroes who have received the true teachings of The Hunt. We come forth to punish Evil Ninja Osaru.
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: Ninja Hero? Huh, it seems that my trial has finally come to an end...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Trial?
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: The final trial of the Mappou Age... Destroy the matrix of Osaru's house and end the catastrophe that has befallen this land.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Pray tell... Have I proven myself worthy of the title of "Ninja Hero"?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: O mighty Aeon of The Hunt! What indomitable ninja spirit she has! Indeed, one as devoted as you rightfully deserves the title of Ninja Hero.
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: Greetings, Dazzling Ninja!
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: Ten arduous years of training finally culminated in this, a new title will be conferred upon me today... I can proudly say that I have never gone against the tenets of Dazzling Ninjutsu all this time. How I wish you were here to witness this glory of mine today, Master Kucha...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: With that, I shall continue my journey to take down the Evil Ninja. Farewell.
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: Make no haste. Since I am now a Ninja Hero fit to contend with the Evil Ninja... Would you let me join you in your crusade?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: No, for your hunt is long complete. This is mine and mine alo—
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: lo—lo—lo—lo—lo—lo—lone...
rows.speaker: "Ninja Hero"

rows.text: Don't worry. Everything's fine now.
rows.speaker: Robin

rows.text: I see... This talent would do well in special effect films.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Ah, we have quite some fascinating actors today. One perpetually films before a green screen, another has been through a change of identities, and...
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: And you, of course. The one with the most potential, Festive Superstar from the Land of the Dreams.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: So, am I right to see your act of betrayal at the Dean's Office as a ruse to teleport us to safety here?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps I was just trying to bail myself out of the situation.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Bana yourself?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The words you speak...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Well, this seems to be the answer for everything. Banagibberish has long infiltrated every cell and organ of our body.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Since Penacony's dreams are rooted in the desires of the masses, the memetic corruption has had an irreversible impact on the Dreamscape itself. Slumbernana Monkey's sweeping craze wasn't the beginning of things. Rather, it heralded the end...
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: From that point onward, the Moment of Slumbernana was fated to be born.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: But what differentiates this from other memetic viruses is the period and extent of its influence, is that right?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm impressed. It seems Dan Heng is not only a skilled actor, but also has profound knowledge on communication theory.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Trends come and go, but every single one of them eventually dies down, much like how a violent storm quells with time. We may not be able to dampen the increasing popularity of Slumbernana Monkey, but we can always work to hasten the trend's recession.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: How do we accomplish this, you ask? We'll have to introduce our lead actor for the night!
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: Yes, it's none other than you, ninja actor.
rows.speaker: Mr. Reca

rows.text: The key is in my "past," isn't it?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Bana, bana. Atavistic target: Old World monkey. Gene regression progress: 7%. Vital signs: Stable.
rows.speaker: Strange Robot

rows.text: This is Evil Ninja Osaru's ninja scout. It is currently monitoring the victims imprisoned in their cages... O mighty Aeon of The Hunt, evildoers have cast their covetous eyes upon the world. How can you continue to slumber with your eyes closed?
Following Master Kucha's instructions, Rappa ventures into the magical vessel made of ninja tech...
Umbra Headmistress and Master Kucha? What are they talking about...?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Warning: Corridor C11's security system has largely gone out of control.

The End
Swallow it, for the sake of the Ninja Capital...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The moment you take the medicine, intense pain overwhelms your senses.
Steel your nerves... A Ninja Hero never fears!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Put it on, for the sake of becoming a Ninja Hero...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Rid all thoughts of escape... Ninja Heroes never flee!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The collar emits powerful electrical currents, like thousands of needles piercing through your flesh and blood, and countless bombs exploding within your body. Your heart begins to beat at an unusual rate. You hear countless noises, including the deaths of protons.
Let the hunt begin, for the sake of defeating evil one day...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: The fiendlings have approached you. Even though it's just practice, you have to take on them with a true hunting attitude!
Turn back around... Ninja Heroes never retreat!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Pray tell, what does it mean to be a Ninja Hero? And how does one become a Ninja Hero?
Through talent? Lineage? Inheritance? Or being possessed by the ninja spirit?
Nay, none of these!
Across the wide expanse of the Cosmic Ninja Realm, those who practice ninjutsu are as prevalent as flying fish roe, yet Ninja Heroes are as rare as precious golden pufferfish.
At this juncture, the legendary scroll of the Ninja Hero is on the cusp of being unfurled. Do your best to maintain your sanity as you watch Dazzling Ninja's past unfold before you...

Part One: Epiphany via Tribulation
Hatch-unlock requested... Insufficient clearance. Please enter password.
An enchantment? It won't stop me!
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: (This is... Rappa's voice. Is this a past version of her?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Rin, Pyou, Tou, Sha... Break!
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: Password input correct. Live specimen gene editing disabled. Opening hatch.
That's all there is to Osaru's seal...? Hah.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: Even while my senses are dulled by sorcery, I can still see the grotesque sins that are unfolding here... How detestable and deplorable indeed.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: (I am now the self that Rappa remembers in her memories... So this is the Ninja Capital? It's completely different from what I imagined...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That should be the end of my trial... Time to return to Master and resume my training.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: Salutations, Master Kucha. I have... deciphered the enchantment.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: Wh—What...? It's not even two system hours...
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Master Kucha, do I... count as a "ninja initiate" now?
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: ...Ahem. Why, yes!
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: O child new to the way of the ninja, I recognize your determination. Henceforth, you shall be the successor to my Dazzling Ninjutsu.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Thank you, Master. This is... my greatest honor.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: Behold the city of shadow! A sinful land of suffering, hatred, and sorrow. Bloody tears soon to devour all hope for the morrow.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Soulless Evil Ninja Osaru, agent of the vile, cast the masses into sin by foul arts and guile. Fiendlings indulgent in evil gone wild, enraged the hearts of all — man, woman, and child.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Inherit the legacy of the Ninja Hero and wipe clean the sins of Osaru. End the suffering wrought upon the Ninja Capital and bring peace back to its people.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: I will continue to train hard... till the day I become the Dazzling Ninja that Master speaks of.
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: An admirable resolution! To contend with the Evil Ninja, you will also need a new name — a name befitting a ninja.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Name...? Is AK-A-3 a name?
rows.speaker: Rappa?

rows.text: I don't know, my disciple. Your name will carry your ideals, your convictions, and your destiny. Your ninja name belongs to you alone.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: So, the decision is yours to make.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: In that case... I choose Rappa. To have a dedicated heart that will never be disturbed, and to pacify all evil and demonstrate justice... that was Master's initial teachings to me. I wish to use them in my name.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: As you wish! Nice to meet you, Dazzling Initiate AKA Rappa! You will now embark on an arduous training to become a ninja. Can you keep up?
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Certainly. Pain is but common to a ninja and I shall never flinch in the face of it.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: A fiendling... No, it is a Dazzling Fiendling under Master Kucha, though not directly. This fiendling harbors just as much hatred for Evil Ninja Osaru.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: No. 3... take medicine...
Secret concoctions of concealed evil. It contains an excessive amount of ninja strength. Swallowing it means enduring bone-shattering pain.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: However, to become a Ninja Hero, I must consume these pills every day... Only then can I create a never-ending source of Cosmic Ninja Strength within my body. Yes, this is a trial to temper my mind and body.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Your skin, muscles, bones... You feel every part of your body being eroded, destroyed, and reconstructed...
(Urk, is this excruciating pain what Rappa endured back then...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Hi-yah! Having persevered through unending nights of tribulations, I will boast... the impenetrable body of a Ninja Hero.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: This is Umbra Headmistress, the head of the dojo and a reliable supportive figure for us Dazzling students.
She uses the Great Narukami Circle to awaken the latent potential of ninjas. After attaining enlightenment via reverse lightning ninjutsu, one's body can then possess extraordinary ninja senses.
No. 3, I am about to increase the intensity. You better be able to handle it. The future of this laboratory is all in your hands.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Yes, that is the plan... The future of the Ninja Capital shall be shaped by the Dazzling Ninja Hero. I will definitely fulfill my promise.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: (This is... too much...!)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Osu! Having persevered through unending nights of tribulations, I now boast... the vast senses of a Ninja Hero.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: These fiendlings are Rebel Apes of Osaru's clan. They would spar with me every day, improving my ninja skills and refining my ninja martial prowess.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: No. 3. Stress Response Training Tier IV. Fighting low-level combat apes...
rows.speaker: Rebel Apes

rows.text: I have never won against these fiendlings, for I am still but a mere ninja initiate.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Yet, if I am to become the Dazzling Ninja, I must vanquish these fiendlings! Only then can I be worthy of defeating Evil Ninja Osaru... To battle! Do not stop until the crows start cawing at the crack of dawn.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: No. 3. Cleared experiment Tier IV... Rating increased...
rows.speaker: Rebel Apes

rows.text: As stated in the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions: "The way of the ninja is long and windy, and trials and tribulations are mere amusements..."
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Osu! Having persevered through unending nights of tribulations, I now boast... the unrivaled stature of a Ninja Hero.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Master Kucha... and Umbra Headmistress?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Use a memetic virus on No. 3... How would that help the experiment?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: I can clearly hear everything they're saying... Is my superhearing capable of picking up even whispers among ninjas now? A joyous discovery indeed.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Denisovan 22, we need to increase No. 3's mental resilience.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Enough with these lame excuses. You just can't bear to see her suffer, can you?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: She might not be able to withstand the later experiments. If we use the memetic virus to perform cognitive intervention and ensure that her mind remains stable, the experiments can proceed more smoothly.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Fine, but make sure not to bring your personal feelings into this. The Research Apes aren't exactly happy about how you are allowing No. 3 to run around at will.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: She's able to decipher the password to the modification cabin in just two system hours. There's no way we'll be able to cage her up like any old gorilla...
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Do not be troubled over me, Master. Mere physical suffering can never devastate my ninja spirit.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Information dilution at 74%. Consciousness anchor locked on. Memetic etching is about to begin.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Ninja Initiate Rappa, are you ready? The illusory sorcery that the Evil Ninja cast upon you is about to be broken!
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Memetic etching is about to begin. Let's get out of here! Or we'll get affected as well.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: I... I see it now! To think, there's such a majestic capital in the Ninja World!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Awesome! Looks like it was a success...
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Since we're on this, why ninjas?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Oh, because of the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: The what now?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: "In order to protect the helpless weak and save the fallen Ninja Capital, the righteous Ninja Hero hunts down the world's Evil Ninjas!"
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: ...It's a manga series. After we sealed off the research institute to hide from the Galaxy Rangers, my manga collection has been her only source of entertainment.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Now I know why No. 3 always looks so loopy...
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: You'd better be careful not to go overboard with giving her such useless information. There's only one horizontal axis on Erudition's coordinate system. Everything else is an impediment to progress.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: That's especially true for the banal concepts of good and evil... Haven't the Galaxy Rangers given us enough trouble already?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: You'll never get the Doctor to notice you if you keep being so narrow-minded.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Is that so? Would Doctor... really notice ordinary mortals like us?
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Part Two: Vanquisher in Dazzle
You're transferring No. 3 to Denisovan 22? Why!?
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Simple. You won't be able to graduate. According to Denisovan 22's reports, you have been guiding the experiment in the wrong direction.
rows.speaker: Research Ape

rows.text: No! Let me ask her what she means by this!
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: It's an honor for me to represent Laboratory 17 and elaborate on our beliefs to all who are present today...
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Wise attendees, as you can clearly see, our universe today is nothing but a crate of abandoned bananas.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: In order to save the worlds marching towards rot and decay, humanity must regress! Regress! And regress further! Only then will civilization be imbued with endless possibilities yet again, allowing Erudition to shine with kaleidoscopic rays once more!
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Do not be concerned by the accusations and criticisms of others, for a grand cause must always use the dreams of the common masses as kindling. Yet, it is blissful for them to become kindling, for rotten wood only contributes the greatest value when it is set ablaze.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: People should make use of their talents to the fullest, just as items should be utilized fully! We must ensure that every "monkey" in the experiment fully comprehends this bliss. Let us burn alongside them in happiness!
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Burn! Burn! Burn!
rows.speaker: Researchers

rows.text: Denisovan 22! What is all this!?
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: I've graduated. Now you need to call me Ape 22.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: As for what this is? That specimen is the new human that our laboratory painstakingly bred with genes filtered from the atavistic experiments, but you made her a lunatic. The Research Apes have decided that I will take over her nurturing from here on out.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Who's in charge isn't important, but you can't continue the experiment anymore. She'll break.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: That's fine. I'm already nurturing No. 4. If something happens to 3, we'll replace her with that new one.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: How could you!? We brought her up since she was a baby! Do you not have a shred of morality!?
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Morality? Are you really talking to me about morality?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: On Bacchus-II, morality is how every family's second son must be sacrificed to Nanook. On the Interstellar Principality of Pegasus, morality is how bipedal organisms must be enslaved by quadrupedal ones. On the Kapakala planet, morality is how blue-eyed individuals are forbidden from walking on the streets.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Morality has bound the wisdom of those people and ended the future of those worlds. That was why Dr. Primitive chose them as targets of the atavistic experiment.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: The sacrifices we made are not for such vulgar things. Rather, they're meant to create a future where humans can be happy, where the universe can continue to advance, and one that the Doctor can be proud of!
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Umbra Headmistress, you're... destroying the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions? Why?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Cognition isolation is the first step to curing one of a memetic virus. You were supposed to have the intelligence of a genius, but such garbage ruined it.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: ...Rip them. Tear them to shreds yourself.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: This... This is the dearest treasure of the Dazzling Ninja school. We cannot do that...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Odd. I've always thought of you as obedient. You always did everything Denisovan 75 said. Why aren't you obeying me?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: —Bam!
Agh... Your muscle fibers sure are densely packed. It's like slapping a rock.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: The palm... Why... used on me...?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Hurry and tear up this trash!
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: As long as you perform well, both Denisovan 75 and I will be praised. You don't wish to disappoint him, do you?
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Master Kucha...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: I understand. This must be Master Kucha's trial for me. He's testing my ninja skills of letting go...
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Denisovan 22! You cannot get rid of her!
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: No. 3 is also a failed experimental subject. She barged into the storage room without permission, created a huge mess, and was rude to the Research Apes. Just that alone is enough to make her a failure.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: But you know that was just an accident.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: I'm a Research Ape, not a BananAdvisor. You're the one who made her into this damned state she is in. The laboratory should hold you accountable for the way she turned out.
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: Damn it...
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Master Kucha, have I... done something wrong?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: ...No, Rappa.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: You have done extremely well. A true Ninja Hero must wholeheartedly devote oneself to the way of the ninja.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: You foiled the Evil Ninja's schemes and saved so many innocent people... You undoubtedly already have the bearing of a true ninja.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Am I really a true ninja now?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Of course... Now, Ninja Initiate Rappa.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Yes, Master.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: You've trained under me for five years. After rigorous tests and trials, you've mastered hundreds of ninja techniques.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: I hereby bestow upon you the title of Dazzling Ninja, entrusting you to be my weapon to defeat the evil ninja and guide the Ninja Capital into the future.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Thank you, Master Kucha. This is my greatest honor...!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Take the scroll with you, for within its pages lie the secrets of Dazzling Ninjutsu. It shall cast a brilliance that makes fiendlings fear and destroy the evil ninja's intricate matrices.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Paint it throughout the Ninja Capital. Banish the shadows with ink, and raise the banner against evil.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: What should I paint?
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: I do not know, my disciple.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: You may paint anything that you wish. This is your own ninjutsu.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: So, the decision is yours to make.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: ...Yes.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: This is where the matrix core is. According to Master, Dazzling Ninjutsu can overwrite the Evil Ninja's matrix.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Channel the mantra into the colorful brilliance, then paint it over the existing mantra on the matrix core... What wondrous ninja tech.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Dazzling Ninja Seal, open!
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Success! This way, the Evil Ninja's matrix can finally be broken.
rows.speaker: Rappa

rows.text: Denisovan 75, what is going on!? There's digital graffiti all over the laboratory. It even crashed the security system!
rows.speaker: "Umbra Headmistress"

rows.text: I have no idea... Someone must've hacked in. I'll check on it right away.
rows.speaker: "Master Kucha"

rows.text: Well be quick about it! If we don't fix it soon, the Rangers are gonna find us!
